approved_translation: Foresight saves those who plan ahead; the heedless perish while the wise escape.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: Once upon a time three Fishes lived in a far-away river. They were named Thoughtful, Very-Thoughtful, and Thoughtless. That let the two Fishes out of the net and away they went to find Very-Thoughtful. "You saved our lives, Very-Thoughtful," they said, "and now we are willing to go back to the wild country." So back they all went to their old home where they lived safely ever after.
